What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
If you live near the equator, you're moving at about one thousand six hundred and seventy kilometers per hour.
You just can't feel it, because everything moves with you.
but not the things on it.
Everything not bolted to bedrock keeps flying east at that speed.
The atmosphere becomes a wind faster than any hurricane in history...
Earth's spin makes it bulge at the middle.
Without the spin, the water slides toward the poles...
leaving one giant continent wrapped around the equator.
Earth's spin is slowing by only about two milliseconds per century.
